claims.head: Watch Seattle’s puck management
claims.call: At least its usual 7.7% of Philadelphia’s 5-on-5 chances come right after winning the puck.
claims.body: Seattle gives up more dangerous chances after losing the puck than most (29th of 32 at avoiding breakdowns). Philadelphia ranks 7th for chances off turnovers.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 4 games this season

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Bruisers against finesse
claims.body: On physicality, Philadelphia sits 8th of 32, at the bruising end of the scale. Seattle is 25th, at the finesse end.
claims.call: Philadelphia hits more than Seattle in the close stretches of the game.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 5 games this season

check.measure: hit score in close games (arena-adjusted, 100 is league average)
check.rule: held if the team comes out ahead by at least half its usual margin; partly if it comes out ahead by less; otherwise didn't happen

PHI.head: The matchup suits Philadelphia
PHI.body: Philadelphia has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Seattle can make it interesting if it keeps the shots to the outside.

SEA.head: Seattle faces a real test
SEA.body: Philadelphia has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Seattle’s best way through is keeping the shots to the outside.
